description: § 453(g)(3) reaches controlled entities and trusts (§ 1239(b)), not family: a rental building sold to your child on the installment method is allowed (Form 6252 line 3 'Yes', Part III applies). Price $300,000, cost $200,000, straight-line depreciation $50,000: gross profit $150,000 on a $300,000 contract price; $60,000 received — $30,000 of § 1231 gain, all unrecaptured § 1250 gain (total $50,000). No second disposition this year.
